name: Oc hut
summary: Ốc hút is the snail snack at Con Market, indoors and in the snack row, and on Phạm Hồng Thái at night.
origin: A Da Nang snack at the market and on the night street.
howToEat: Order it at Con Market, or on Phạm Hồng Thái after dark.
where: Con Market’s indoor counters and the snack row, with bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo, kem bơ, and chè. Phạm Hồng Thái serves it at night.
seoTitle: Oc hut — snails in Da Nang
seoDescription: Ốc hút is the snail snack at Con Market and on Phạm Hồng Thái at night.
